field_changes.old: Periodization is now fully live on iOS! Upgrade to Elite or set a routine as your current plan and you'll be walked through a personalized setup — including an equipment check and a "Week 1 is ready" confirmation so you can dive in with confidence. Load progression is smarter too: for assisted exercises, the app now correctly understands that less resistance means harder, keeping your weight targets right on track.
field_changes.new: Adaptive Plans just got more personal! You can now set a Cardio Finishers preference to include or skip cardio at the end of your sessions, and pick your preferred training split right from the start. Not on an Adaptive Plan yet? A new pop-up makes it easy to jump in. We've also refreshed the ratings popup with a friendly new look, plus a handful of fixes.
